note: Only valid while the webcam stays at the same height and angle. After moving it, photograph a mm ruler beside the dish and re-measure. A ruler at the top of the frame read 14.6 px/mm, so the camera is tilted slightly: expect up to ~5% scale error until it is levelled or calibrated with the ruler where the dish sits.
setup_note: Dish on white printer paper, front-lit. Pale yellow objects differ from white paper by only ~11 colour units, hence threshold 10. Add dish_center_px [x, y] once the dish has a marked spot.
